source_text: {Computational methods to approximate the solution of differential equations play a crucial role in science, engineering, mathematics, and technology. Indeed, the key processes which govern the physical world---wave propagation, thermodynamics, fluid flow, solid deformation, gas dynamics, electricity and magnetism, quantum mechanics, general relativity, and many more---are described by differential equations, and we depend on numerical methods for the ability to simulate, explore, predict, and control systems involving these processes. The variety of differential equation problems that arise in these applications is vast, and much research has gone into developing numerical methods which can solve different problems accurately and efficiently. Mathematical analysis of these algorithms plays an essential role, furnishing rigorous validation to particular methods in clearly delineated circumstances, supplying quantitative error bounds, and enabling comparison among competing methods. In this book we will focus on finite element methods, a vast class of numerical methods for differential equations which is of wide applicability and great utility, and also, not coincidentally, one for which there is an extensive body of mathematical analysis.}
translated_text: {求微分方程近似解的计算方法在科学、工程、数学和技术中起着至关重要的作用. 事实上, 支配物理世界的关键过程, 包括波的传播、热力学、流体流动、固体变形、气体动力学、电磁现象、量子力学、广义相对论以及许多其他过程, 都由微分方程描述; 我们依靠数值方法来模拟、探索、预测和控制涉及这些过程的系统. 这些应用中出现的微分方程问题种类繁多, 人们为发展能够准确、高效地求解不同问题的数值方法进行了大量研究. 对这些算法的数学分析起着不可或缺的作用: 在明确界定的情形下为特定方法提供严格论证, 给出定量误差界, 并使不同方法之间的比较成为可能. 本书着重讨论有限元方法. 这是一大类求解微分方程的数值方法, 适用范围广、用途大; 与此相应, 关于这类方法也有大量数学分析成果, 这并非偶然.}

source_text: {The finite element method is a mature tool, in both practice and theory, in many areas of computational science. Nonetheless, the variety of partial differential equations (PDEs) which arise is vast, and there are still many important problems for which the known numerical approaches fail, and good numerical methods are yet to be devised. Consequently, research aimed at devising and analyzing new methods is flourishing. Traditionally, the key mathematical tools for the study of numerical PDEs, and especially of finite element methods, have come from functional analysis: Hilbert and Banach spaces, the Hilbert projection theorem, the Lax–Milgram lemma, the Bramble–Hilbert lemma, duality, Sobolev spaces, etc. The finite element exterior calculus (FEEC), presented in this book, also depends essentially on functional analysis, especially the theory of closed unbounded operators on Hilbert space. But FEEC's mathematical arsenal goes well beyond functional analysis, bringing in tools from geometry and topology to develop and analyze numerical methods for classes of PDEs resistant to more traditional approaches. Methods derived from FEEC are prime examples of structure-preserving numerical methods, in that they are designed to preserve key geometric, topological, and algebraic structures of the PDE at the discrete level. This turns out to be crucial to the development of successful finite element methods for a variety of problems for which standard methods fail. Specifically, FEEC focuses on PDEs which relate to complexes of differential operators acting on Hilbert function spaces and uses finite element spaces which form subcomplexes of these complexes, and which can be related to them via commuting projections.}
translated_text: {在计算科学的许多领域, 有限元方法在实践和理论上都是成熟的工具. 尽管如此, 所出现的偏微分方程 (PDE) 种类繁多, 仍有许多重要问题使现有数值途径失效, 有效的数值方法尚有待构造. 因此, 致力于构造和分析新方法的研究蓬勃发展. 传统上, 数值 PDE, 特别是有限元方法研究所用的关键数学工具来自泛函分析: Hilbert 空间和 Banach 空间、Hilbert 投影定理、Lax–Milgram 引理、Bramble–Hilbert 引理、对偶性、Sobolev 空间等. 本书介绍的有限元外微积分 (FEEC) 同样实质性地依赖泛函分析, 尤其是 Hilbert 空间上闭无界算子的理论. 但是, FEEC 的数学工具远不止于泛函分析: 它引入几何和拓扑的工具, 为那些较传统途径难以处理的 PDE 类发展和分析数值方法. 从 FEEC 导出的方法是保结构数值方法的典型例子, 因为这些方法旨在离散层次保留 PDE 的关键几何、拓扑和代数结构. 事实表明, 对于标准方法失效的多种问题, 这是发展有效有限元方法的关键. 具体而言, FEEC 着眼于与 Hilbert 函数空间上微分算子复形相关的 PDE, 使用构成这些复形的子复形、并且能通过交换投影与原复形联系起来的有限元空间.}

source_text: {While FEEC's antecedents go back decades, to the early days of the finite element method and even before, it first began to be defined as a distinct theory in my presentation to the International Congress of Mathematicians in 2002 \BookCite{5} and was formalized in two long papers I coauthored with Richard Falk and Ragnar Winther in 2006 \BookCite{11} and 2010 \BookCite{13}. The first paper emphasized a particular complex of differential operators, namely, the de Rham complex of differential forms on a domain in $\mathbb R^3$ (or a Riemannian manifold). It was here that the name \emph{finite element exterior calculus} first appeared, referring to the calculus of differential forms. In the 2010 paper, more emphasis was put on the abstract structure of a Hilbert complex, of which the $L^2$ de Rham complex is a special case, allowing FEEC to deal with other complexes that arise in other applications.}
translated_text: {虽然 FEEC 的先驱工作可以追溯到几十年前, 即有限元方法的早期甚至更早, 但它作为一种独立理论, 最初开始形成于我在 2002 年国际数学家大会上的报告 \BookCite{5}, 并在我与 Richard Falk 和 Ragnar Winther 合作撰写的两篇长文, 即 2006 年的 \BookCite{11} 和 2010 年的 \BookCite{13}, 中得到了形式化表述. 第一篇论文着重研究一个特定的微分算子复形, 即 $\mathbb R^3$ 中区域 (或 Riemannian 流形) 上微分形式的 de Rham 复形. \emph{有限元外微积分}这一名称正是在那里首次出现的, 其中的外微积分指微分形式的微积分. 在 2010 年的论文中, 我们更加重视 Hilbert 复形的抽象结构; $L^2$ de Rham 复形是它的一个特例, 这使 FEEC 能够处理其他应用中出现的其他复形.}

source_text: {By June 2012 the basic outlines of FEEC theory were in place, and I was fortunate to be offered the opportunity to present an intensive short course on FEEC to an audience of nearly 70 faculty members, graduate students, and other researchers from around the world. The course was generously supported by the National Science Foundation and the Conference Board of the Mathematical Sciences as part of the NSF-CBMS conference series and expertly hosted at the Institute of Computational and Experimental Research in Mathematics (ICERM) at Brown University. This book grew out of that course. It shares with the course the goal of helping numerical analysts to master the fundamentals of FEEC, including the geometrical and functional analysis preliminaries, quickly and in one place. But the book has a broader audience in mind than the course, aiming to be accessible as well to mathematicians and students of mathematics from areas other than numerical analysis who are interested in understanding how techniques from geometry and topology come to play a role in numerical PDE. FEEC has been vigorously developing in the time since the course, and so the book contains much more material than was taught in the course, some of which was not even developed at that time.}
translated_text: {到 2012 年 6 月, FEEC 理论的基本轮廓已经形成. 我有幸获得机会, 为来自世界各地的近 70 名教师、研究生和其他研究人员开设了一门 FEEC 集中短期课程. 作为 NSF-CBMS 系列会议的一部分, 该课程得到国家科学基金会和数学科学会议委员会的慷慨资助, 并由 Brown University 的数学计算与实验研究所 (ICERM) 出色地承办. 本书由这门课程发展而来. 它与课程有着相同的目标: 帮助数值分析工作者在一处快速掌握 FEEC 的基础, 包括所需的几何和泛函分析预备知识. 但本书面向的读者比课程更广, 还希望数值分析之外其他领域的数学家和数学专业学生也能阅读, 只要他们有兴趣了解几何和拓扑技术如何在数值 PDE 中发挥作用. 课程之后, FEEC 一直在蓬勃发展, 因此本书包含的内容远多于课程所讲的内容, 其中一些内容在当时甚至尚未形成.}

source_text: {The first portion of the book, Chapters~\ref{chap:introduction}--\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}, quickly develops the prerequisite material from homological algebra, algebraic topology, and functional analysis. These ingredients are combined in the basic structure of a Hilbert complex studied in Chapter~\ref{chap:hilbert-complexes}. Remaining in this general abstract framework, the approximation of problems related to Hilbert complexes is developed in Chapter~\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}. The second portion of the book consists of Chapters~\ref{chap:exterior-calculus} and~\ref{chap:finite-element-differential-forms}, where we apply the general theory to the most canonical example of a Hilbert complex, the $L^2$ de Rham complex on a domain in $\mathbb R^n$. Finally, in the closing chapter we briefly survey some other examples and applications.}
translated_text: {本书的第一部分, 即 Chapters~\ref{chap:introduction}--\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}, 简要而迅速地建立所需的同调代数、代数拓扑和泛函分析预备知识. 这些要素在 Chapter~\ref{chap:hilbert-complexes} 所研究的 Hilbert 复形这一基本结构中结合起来. 仍在这一一般抽象框架内, Chapter~\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes} 建立与 Hilbert 复形相关的问题的逼近理论. 本书第二部分由 Chapters~\ref{chap:exterior-calculus} 和~\ref{chap:finite-element-differential-forms} 组成, 将一般理论应用于 Hilbert 复形最典型的例子, 即 $\mathbb R^n$ 中区域上的 $L^2$ de Rham 复形. 最后, 在结尾一章中, 我们简要介绍其他一些例子和应用.}
